aarti.tek: The āratī of Śrī Sāī, the revered Guru, ever supreme bliss, the best of gods, whose grace brings abundant happiness and takes away sorrow, grief, trouble and fear.
aarti.pad1: He took incarnation at Shirdi, and by miracles showed the truth. So many devotees came to his feet, and they found lasting happiness and peace. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: As is the feeling one holds in the mind, so is the experience one receives. Whoever applies the Guru's udī to the body, that person's mind finds peace. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Whoever always sings Sāī's name gains an everlasting reward in the world. One who offers worship and service on Thursday receives the Gurudeva's grace. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: He gives darśana in the form of Rāma, Kṛṣṇa and Hanumān, as each knows him in the mind. Followers of many faiths come, and having had his darśana, they gain the fruit they wish for. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Say: victory to Sāī Bābā! Say: victory to the Avadhūta Guru! Sāīdāsa sings the āratī; dwelling at home, he finds happiness and blessing. ॥5॥
